text: As part of CreateTO’s ongoing commitment to maintaining competitive compensation and fostering employee retention, the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO is recommending the implementation of a cost-of-living adjustment ("COLA") within the Board-approved budget. This annual practice aligns with the City of Toronto’s approved increase and reflects the organization’s responsiveness to economic conditions.

The Board of Directors, CreateTO: 1. Approved and directed the Chief Executive Officer to implement a Cost-of-Living Adjustment (COLA) for all CreateTO employees for the 2026 fiscal year, aligned with the percentage provided by the City of Toronto to its non-union employees.
